integrity: Complete standalone exact integer checker provided; all theorem claims are proved algebraically and finite tests are independent corroboration. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only Q(0)=0 nondegenerate quadratic forms on F_2^(2m), m>=2, real indicator windows and full Walsh time-frequency orbit. Only real-symmetric matrix recovery; complex lifting retains its skew-symmetric kernel. Condition number is for exact linear lifting; finite checks corroborate but do not prove the universal theorem. Priority comparison is bounded.
title: Real Gabor tomography from nondegenerate Boolean quadrics
